description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Shadow of the New Moon: Inspired Eclipse also offers the inspired creature Invisibility (until its next turn) and a 30-ft teleport with its Reaction. Vibrance of the Full Moon: Lunar Vitality can use 1d6 instead of spending a Bardic Inspiration die (module).

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Recipient Invisibility + teleport and the free 1d6 Lunar Vitality (module).
